titulo_fr: Raconter une expérience : Repérer les informations
intro: It follows past experience and recognizes the contrast between background and successive actions. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It follows past experience and recognizes the contrast between background and successive actions. It relates the matter to the request and checks the dates, conditions and actions that the message asks to perform.
The point of attention: The imparfait describes a situation or custom; the passé composé reports limited facts. In this fragment, «randonnée» means «excursion».

frases.fr: Quand j'étais enfant, nous passions souvent les vacances chez mes grands-parents.
frases.es: Cuando era niño, pasábamos a menudo las vacaciones en casa de mis abuelos.
frases.en: When I was a kid, we often spent my grandparents' holidays.

frases.fr: Un été, nous avons fait une randonnée dans les Alpes et nous avons perdu le chemin.
frases.es: Un verano hicimos una excursión en los Alpes y perdimos el camino.
frases.en: One summer we took a trip in the Alps and we lost our way.
